summary: Plum Acquisition Corp. IV filed an 8-K postponing its extraordinary general meeting from July 2 to July 10, 2026, to allow additional shareholder engagement on a proposed extension amendment. The amendment would push the initial business combination deadline to January 16, 2027 (or up to July 16, 2027 with monthly extensions). No business combination, deal terms, or binding action were announced; the filing is a procedural scheduling change for a routine special-purpose acquisition company extension vote. This is not a special-situation event.
